svg.title: Canadian no-fee banking stack
svg.desc: Spending account at Simplii or Tangerine, emergency HISA at EQ Bank, optional small Big-5 leftover for drafts. As of 21 Sep 2026.
svg.text: A no-fee stack, not a single hero account
Move payroll only after cards work. As of 21 Sep 2026.
Simplii (CIBC ATMs + cash deposits) or Tangerine (Scotiabank ABMs). $0 package. One to two weeks of bills.

text.tspan: EQ Personal 2.75% with $2,000/month qualifying DD (1.00% without). Or another everyday HISA.
Tiny Big-5 or credit-union account only for drafts, cash-heavy exceptions, or a mortgage login. Not a $30

svg.text: Joint PADs need a joint spending account. Government benefits are individual in CRA My Account.

text.tspan: Simplii welcome $300 + $50 Skip and Tangerine $250 payroll bonus are dated offer types (used 21 Sep 2026) - never

svg.text: EQ: no cash, no cheques. Confirm CDIC member names. Education only.
